The Supabase MCP connector (mcp__Supabase__execute_sql), which does not go through this sandbox's local egress proxy, WAS reachable and confirmed against the correct project (ref dufyzxtrhdcwrebagsfs, name 'Pumo Feeder', region us-east-2 — matches architecture.md §8). Each check below was therefore run as `set role anon; <statement>;` inside a single Supabase SQL session, which exercises the exact same column grants and RLS policies (contract.md §2) that PostgREST/the REST API enforces for the anon/publishable-key role — not a literal HTTP POST/PATCH/DELETE. Flagged as a deviation per contract.md's 'follow it anyway and note the concern; don't silently deviate.' A literal HTTP-level re-run against LIVE_URL's Supabase project is recommended once network access allows (e.g. from the orchestrator's environment), but is not expected to behave differently since the enforcement point (Postgres grants + RLS) is identical either way.
